evidence.claim: Dunext dal 2023 produce sistemi di accumulo a batterie da 50 kWh a oltre 5 MWh per commerciale, industriale e utility, con cinque filiali estere.
evidence.quote: Founded in 2023, Dunext is one of the leading battery energy storage system manufacturers focused on one-stop commercial, industrial, and utility-scale energy storage solutions. || With five overseas subsidiaries and offices, Dunext supports customers and partners across global battery energy storage projects || Dunext provides scalable commercial, industrial, and utility energy storage solutions, with BESS systems ranging from compact 50 kWh units to over 5 MWh.
